start: Gym whose members already use batches; Add member sheet open

user_sees: One row of chips: each batch in use with its member count, most used first, then "None" and "+ New batch"
"None" is picked
must_not: The same batch twice in different spellings
A batch carried only by nobody

steps.action: Tap a batch chip, fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: The member's page with "{batch} batch · Member since {date}" under the name
must_not: The member saved with no batch
A new spelling of the batch made

start: Gym with batches in use, one of them "Morning 6-8"; Add member sheet open

user_sees: A box "New batch name" in focus, placeholder "Evening 6-9", hint "Up to 40 letters."
must_not: The box closing while it is still empty

steps.action: Type "morning  6-8" (small letters, two spaces), fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: The member is in the existing "Morning 6-8" batch
must_not: A second chip "morning 6-8" next time the form opens

start: Gym where no member has a batch yet; Add member sheet open

user_sees: A plain text box, placeholder "Morning 6-8", hint "The time they train. Next time, you can pick it with one tap."
No chips
must_not: An empty chip row with only "None"

steps.action: Type "Evening 6-9", fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"; then open "+ Add member" again
user_sees: A chip "Evening 6-9" with count 1, "None" and "+ New batch"
must_not: The text box alone again

start: Add member sheet open, "+ New batch" tapped

steps.action: Type a batch name of 41 letters, fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: Under New batch name: "The batch name can be at most 40 letters."
must_not: The name cut to 40 letters and saved without a word
The member saved

steps.action: Leave the new batch name empty and tap "Add member"
user_sees: The member is saved with no batch
must_not: An empty-named batch chip

start: The page of a member who is the only one in the batch "Ladies 11-12"

user_sees: The chip "Ladies 11-12" is picked
must_not: "None" picked for a member who has a batch

user_sees: The page no longer shows a batch under the name
must_not: The batch still on the member

user_sees: No "Ladies 11-12" chip (nobody carries it now)
must_not: A chip with count 0
